excerpt.zh:
我们正在召集高通量灵能单元，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中具有力量的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为奢华之物。
excerpt.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Luxurious Being.

texts.zh:

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为奢华之物。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of high-capacity telepath units, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of significant power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the Luxurious Being.

texts.zh:
我们躺入了虚境中的一片闲适的宁静，发现自己被拉入了奢华之物鎏金的大堂。

丝绸般的诱惑在我们的意识中穿行，就像一幅绚丽多彩的挂毯在面前展开。放纵的疏忽有可能使我们的心智在丰富负担的重压下变得迟钝不堪。

黄金之幻梦给予我们超出理解的奢华。
texts.en:
As we relaxed into a pocket of idle tranquility within the Shroud, we found ourselves drawn into the gilded halls of the Luxurious Being.

Silken temptations coursed through our minds as a rich tapestry of splendor unfurled before us. Indulgent negligence threatened to render our thoughts inert from the weight of its opulent burden.

The Golden Dream offers us luxuries beyond comprehension.
